meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: Claude 能够查询癌症依赖性图谱（DepMap）数据库，获取 CRISPR 基因依赖分数、药物敏感性数据和基因效应图谱，用于识别癌症特异性脆弱性、合成致死相互作用和验证肿瘤药物靶点。
howto.when: 当你提到癌症基因依赖、合成致死、药物靶点验证等关键词，或要求查询 DepMap 数据库时触发。

say.text: 查询 KRAS 在肺癌细胞系中的 CRISPR 依赖分数。
分析 BRCA1 突变细胞系中哪些基因是合成致死靶点。
say.note: 对比突变与野生型细胞系的基因效应，找出选择性必需基因。

say.text: 查找与 EGFR 共同必需的基因。
say.note: 通过相关性分析返回与 EGFR 依赖图谱最相似的基因列表。

howto.what_en: Claude can query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) to retrieve CRISPR gene dependency scores, drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles, helping identify cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validate oncology drug targets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention cancer gene dependency, synthetic lethality, drug target validation, or request DepMap queries.

say_en.text: Query CRISPR dependency scores for KRAS in lung cancer cell lines.
say_en.note: Returns Chronos scores and dependency assessment for KRAS in lung lines.

say_en.text: Analyze synthetic lethal targets in BRCA1-mutant cell lines.

say_en.note: Returns genes with most correlated dependency profiles to EGFR.
